convert_checkpoint_to_generator_and_dete: convert a PyTorch checkpoint into separate generator and detector checkpoint files for inference
run_convert_cli: run the checkpoints script via CLI to split a combined model checkpoint into generator and detector files
extract_inference_config: extract inference-related configuration parameters like seanet, channels, dtype, and sample_rate from a checkpoint
split_model_layers: split model layers by prefix into separate generator and detector checkpoint dictionaries
save_separate_checkpoints: save generator and detector checkpoints as separate .pth files with configurable prefix and suffix
